description: Land Title Settlement Department - Moratumulla, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520202 (7746)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title amendments under the Registration of Title Act, specifically addressing the expungement of particulars for multiple parcels of land in various locations. It contains detailed land descriptions including parcel numbers, block numbers, cadastral maps, village names, Grama Niladhari divisions, and administrative divisions. The content falls squarely under land and property-related matters, making it a clear Land Gazette (Type 4) according to the classification criteria.
